note: Closed vocabulary of rejection keywords. 'deterministic' keywords are detected by Python from Agent 5's verified checks. 'judgment' keywords can only be selected by Gemini from this fixed list, and only when Agent 5's own explanations clearly support them -- Gemini can never invent a new keyword. Wording of the invalid-reason and proof keywords must stay in sync with Agent 5's app/knowledge_base/incomplete_exam_policy.json.

late_submission.label: Late submission
late_submission.policy_basis: An Incomplete Exam request must be submitted within the allowed number of working days after the missed exam.
late_submission.plain_reason: Your request was submitted {working_days_elapsed} working days after the missed exam, but the policy allows a maximum of {limit_working_days} working days.

no_proof_provided.label: No proof provided
no_proof_provided.policy_basis: Supporting proof is required for an Incomplete Exam request.
no_proof_provided.plain_reason: No supporting proof was provided with your request, and the policy requires supporting proof for an Incomplete Exam.

excluded_exam_type.label: Excluded exam type
excluded_exam_type.policy_basis: Certain exam types are excluded from Incomplete Exam consideration.
excluded_exam_type.plain_reason: The exam type ({exam_type}) is not eligible for an Incomplete Exam under the policy.

no_enrollment_record.label: No enrollment record
no_enrollment_record.policy_basis: The student must have been enrolled in the course, section, and term of the missed exam.
no_enrollment_record.plain_reason: No enrollment record was found for you in this course, section, and term, so the request could not be linked to a course you were registered in.

invalid_reason_schedule_misread.label: Misreading the exam schedule
invalid_reason_schedule_misread.policy_basis: Misreading the exam schedule is explicitly listed as an invalid reason for an Incomplete Exam.

invalid_reason_personal_travel.label: Personal / discretionary travel
invalid_reason_personal_travel.policy_basis: Personal or discretionary travel not related to an emergency (for example vacation or planned personal trips) is explicitly listed as an invalid reason. Emergency-driven travel is evaluated like any other emergency claim and is NOT covered by this keyword.

invalid_reason_job_obligation.label: Standard job obligations
invalid_reason_job_obligation.policy_basis: Standard job obligations are explicitly listed as an invalid reason for an Incomplete Exam.

proof_not_acceptable_category.label: Proof not in an accepted category
proof_not_acceptable_category.policy_basis: Accepted proof is limited to the categories in the policy reference. The submitted proof does not match any of them.

proof_inconsistent_or_unverifiable.label: Proof inconsistent or could not be accepted
proof_inconsistent_or_unverifiable.policy_basis: The submitted document does not support the stated reason, or could not be accepted as valid proof of it.
